thread:
Anika: Quick design pass for the Compliance settings page. Two new items: region fallback messaging when a selected region is unavailable, and the retention "Custom" slider accessibility. PTAL.

Priya: Nice. For region fallback, product asked the default behavior to be: if a chosen region has no capacity, fall back to nearest region and surface an inline warning. Need copy that's clear and non-technical. Current mock says: 'Using fallback region: us-west-2'  feels terse.

Jorge: Agreed. Suggest: 'Selected region unavailable. Requests will be routed to us-west-2 until capacity returns.' Add a link 'Learn more' to docs about data residency implications. Also include an icon and role="status" so AT announces it.

Lee: Important: mention what "nearest" means. Ops wants to avoid implying mirrored data residency. Maybe: 'Requests routed to us-west-2 (temporary). Data staying in-region is prioritized when capacity resumes.' Keep it short.

Anika: Draft copy: `Selected region unavailable. Temporarily routing requests to us-west-2. Data residency rules still apply; contact support for strict residency needs.` Should we say 'routing' vs 'processing'?

Sam: Use 'processed' instead of 'routed'  more accurate. And add `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers pick up the change only when it appears.

Priya: OK. Also UX nit: the fallback banner uses orange which looks like an error in other places. Can we switch to a neutral info blue with a small shield icon for compliance-sensitive messages?

Jorge: +1 to color change. Keep contrast >= 4.5:1.

Anika: Moving on to retention custom slider. Design currently shows a compact slider 1-365 days with labels only at ends and a numeric input next to it. Accessibility issues: keyboard users can't set fine-grained days easily, and the screen reader reads 'slider 50 percent' which is meaningless.

Lee: For SR, we should expose the numeric value as `aria-valuetext` like 'Retention duration: 120 days'. Also provide step arrows and allow typing. For keyboard: left/right adjust by 1 day, shift+arrow adjust by 30 days. Add `role="slider"` with proper min/max/step attributes.

Sam: Also expose presets as radio buttons above the slider (30d, 90d, 365d, Custom). When Custom selected, the slider becomes enabled and focus moves to the numeric input. That preserves both keyboard and screen-reader flows.

Priya: Copy nit: the helper text currently says 'Longer retention = more cost'. Replace with `Longer retention retains more logs and may increase storage cost.` Be explicit for legal.

Jorge: Audit export CSV: QA flagged inconsistent header names. Currently: `actor, event, time, details`. We should standardize to `actor, action, timestamp_utc, resource, details`. Include timezone in export or normalize to UTC and add timezone column.

Lee: Prefer normalized `timestamp_utc` plus `tz_offset` column so downstream tools can reconstruct local times. Also ensure the export uses ISO8601 with Z for UTC. Eg `2024-04-10T21:23:00Z`.

Anika: Good. Also audit log on the UI should display local timezone but include hover to show the exported ISO line. New wording for row events: `Actor <name> updated retention from 30d to 180d (policy: org-default)` instead of the generic 'User changed retention'.

Sam: Minor UX: add an icon button on each audit row to copy the canonical CSV row for quick sharing with security teams. Keyboard focusable and has `aria-label="Copy audit row"`.

Priya: One more: region dropdown when unavailable currently disables the control entirely. That's confusing. Better to keep it enabled but show an inline help text `Region currently has no capacity — selecting will queue a request` or something. But product forbids queuing region provisioning, so we should say `Region currently unavailable` and show a tooltip 'Contact sales for region reservation'.

Jorge: Implementation note for tooltip accessibility: make it reachable via keyboard (tab to the info button) and ensure it isn't the only way to get the info (also in the inline aria-describedby text).

Anika: Summary action items I'll take: update fallback banner copy and color, add `aria-live="polite"` + role=status, change fallback icon to shield, implement slider ARIA with aria-valuetext and step rules, wire up radio presets with Custom enable state, change helper copy for cost, standardize CSV headers and timezone handling (timestamp_utc + tz_offset), add copy-audit-row affordance, keep region enabled with explanatory help and contact link, and ensure all tooltips are keyboard actionable.

audit-bot: Accessibility task created: https://redwood.internal/tasks/COM-1717210000-a11y (auto-generated).

Lee: I'll review the updated figma after you push changes. Thanks all.

Anika: Thanks  will push a PR with specs and examples for the audit CSV along with the updated mocks. :shipit:
